note: record/value fields use the OLP implementation-neutral conformance projection; this JSON file is not a Marketplace wire format

positive_records.note: A fix intent with exact reward and validity terms.
Proposal is a MarketIntent profile with an immutable response reference.
Agreement binds exact parties, terms, commitment, and source records; assent proofs remain detached.
MarketEvent refers to the agreement and commitment without mutating either.

negative_records.note: Mutable state is not part of MarketIntent content.
response_to is not silently interpreted without the proposal profile.
Set-like subject arrays must be OLP-CIE-1 sorted.
Commitment principal must be present in agreement parties.
A MarketEvent must identify what it concerns.
Core timestamp profile uses canonical UTC-second form.
response_to must reference Records, not Proofs.

positive_structures.note: Monetary expression is exact and does not assert fair value.
Location semantics are profile-defined, not hard-coded globally.

negative_structures.note: ISO-style currency codes are uppercase in this helper structure.
Offset variants are rejected by the core canonical timestamp profile.
A subject binding has exactly one target.
Settlement preference modes are closed in core-v1.
